##### Project General Facts

The Amargo 2 project is a prestigious development featuring spacious villas with elegant exteriors crafted to showcase luxury and function. With beautiful layouts and state-of-the-art designs, these villas offer a wealth of space, inside and out, allowing residents to build the future they have always wanted for themselves and their loved ones. The villas boast top floors that can be tailored to meet individual needs, whether it be a gaming room, yoga studio, library, or perhaps even a room for a new addition to the family.

The project's amenities are designed to provide residents with endless opportunities for entertainment, relaxation, and recreation. The Sports Town area is equipped with an outdoor gym, cricket pitch and nets, tennis and paddle tennis courts, volleyball, basketball, and football facilities, offering hours of exhilaration for sports enthusiasts. Additionally, the community features a Cinema, where residents can enjoy a movie under the stars, and a Malibu Beach area, perfect for a summer tan or a relaxing day out.

The interior of the villas is finished with modern materials, providing a high-quality living space that is both comfortable and stylish. With plenty of room for comfort, the villas are designed to meet the needs of discerning residents who value elegance and sophistication. The beautiful layouts and state-of-the-art designs ensure that every aspect of the villas is carefully considered to provide a superior living experience. The spacious interiors and expansive private garden areas create a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living, allowing residents to make the most of their living space.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills 2 is a strategically located community, providing easy access to four major highways and other networks that put the city within easy reach. The community is situated near several major landmarks, including the Dubai Camel Racing Club, Dubai Miracle Garden, and Arabian Ranches. The proximity to these attractions makes Damac Hills 2 an ideal location for those who want to experience the best of Dubai's entertainment and leisure offerings. The community is also close to several major roads, including the Emirates Road and Al Qudra Road, making it easily accessible by car.

The location of Damac Hills 2 offers a unique blend of natural beauty and urban convenience, with plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities and entertainment. Residents can enjoy a round of golf at the nearby Jumeirah Golf Estates or explore the beautiful scenery of the Dubai Investments Park. The community is also close to several major shopping malls, including the Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Mall, providing easy access to a wide range of retail and dining options. The nearby Academic City Road and Jebel Ali - Lehbab Road provide additional connections to the city's major business and education hubs.

The Damac Hills 2 community is surrounded by a range of amenities and attractions, including the Hamdan Sports Complex, Nshama Mudon, and Reem Aviation World. The nearby Al Barari and Dubai Hills areas offer additional options for dining, entertainment, and leisure activities. The community is also close to several major schools and universities, making it an ideal location for families and students. The proximity to Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport provides easy access to international travel and commerce. The location of Damac Hills 2 offers a unique and desirable lifestyle, with plenty of opportunities for work, leisure, and entertainment.
